## {background-color="#000000"}

```{=html}
<div id="break-slide" style="
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 100%;
  color: white;
  font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
  text-align: center;
  gap: 1.2em;
">

  <div style="font-size: 2em; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 0.05em;">☕ BREAK</div>

  <!-- Donut timer SVG — radius 75, circumference 471.24 -->
  <svg width="180" height="180" viewBox="0 0 180 180">
    <circle cx="90" cy="90" r="75"
      fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="14"/>
    <circle id="donut-ring-BREAKID" cx="90" cy="90" r="75"
      fill="none" stroke="#EF7C00" stroke-width="14"
      stroke-dasharray="471.24" stroke-dashoffset="0"
      stroke-linecap="round"
      transform="rotate(-90 90 90)"/>
    <text id="timer-text-BREAKID" x="90" y="98"
      text-anchor="middle"
      font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif"
      font-size="32" font-weight="bold"
      fill="white">05:00</text>
  </svg>

  <!-- ANECDOTE — replace with a subject-relevant fun fact for this week -->
  <div style="
    max-width: 560px;
    font-size: 0.95em;
    color: #cccccc;
    line-height: 1.5;
    font-style: italic;
    padding: 0 1em;
  ">
    <!-- TODO: insert a fun fact or anecdote relevant to this week's topic -->
    Did you know? The first large-scale collaborative filtering system,
    <strong style="color:#EF7C00">GroupLens</strong> (1994), was built to help
    Usenet readers filter news articles — years before Netflix or Amazon
    made recommendations mainstream.
  </div>

  <button id="break-btn-BREAKID" onclick="startBreakTimer_BREAKID()" style="
    margin-top: 0.4em;
    padding: 0.5em 2em;
    font-size: 1em;
    font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
    background: #EF7C00;
    color: white;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  ">▶ Start Timer</button>

</div>

<script>
(function() {
  var TOTAL = 5 * 60;                    // ← change minutes here if needed
  var CIRC  = 2 * Math.PI * 75;          // 471.24
  var remaining = TOTAL;
  var interval  = null;

  function pad(n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; }

  function render(sec) {
    var m = Math.floor(sec / 60), s = sec % 60;
    document.getElementById('timer-text-BREAKID').textContent = pad(m)+':'+pad(s);
    var offset = CIRC * (1 - sec / TOTAL);
    document.getElementById('donut-ring-BREAKID').setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', offset);
  }

  window.startBreakTimer_BREAKID = function() {
    if (interval) return;
    var btn = document.getElementById('break-btn-BREAKID');
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.textContent = '⏱ Running…';
    interval = setInterval(function() {
      remaining -= 1;
      render(remaining);
      if (remaining <= 0) {
        clearInterval(interval); interval = null;
        btn.textContent = "✓ Time's up!";
        document.getElementById('donut-ring-BREAKID').setAttribute('stroke','#00c875');
      }
    }, 1000);
  };

  render(remaining);
})();
</script>
```

::: notes
Break slide. Start the timer when you announce the break. The anecdote is displayed automatically — no action needed.
:::
